_meta.intent: Dictionary is a behavioral spec: state × interaction × display rule. Agent uses it to: (1) pick the right state from spec context, (2) apply display rules to layers, (3) wire onClick / Prototype based on interactions.
v4_additions: 1. avatarThumbnail also has _inferred_user_flow per state (parity with Avatar Card)
2. default_state field per component (which state to assume when spec is ambiguous)
3. agent_usage_hint with spec_signal_to_state / spec_signal_to_variant mappings + common_combinations examples
4. caveats[] unified array (replaces old notes/constraints/highlights with severity-tagged structure)
5. related_components[] with appears_alongside (keys included) + appears_on_screens + navigates_to

_meta.inference_disclaimer: All `_inferred*` fields are Claude's interpretation, not Hori-confirmed. Wang should review with Hori and mark/remove false ones.

components.name: profile/avatarThumbnail

catalog_description.usage_jp: プロフィール画面のアバターサムネイル。ModelとStatusの組み合わせで表示を切り替える。
catalog_description.usage_en: Avatar thumbnail on Profile screen. Switch display by Model and Status combination.

_variant_aliases._note: Hori's variant values explained in plain terms (Claude-authored — Hori may refine).

Model.selfVideo: User viewing their own avatar in normal video mode
Model.selfInCallVideo: User viewing their own avatar while in call mode
Model.OtherVideo: User viewing another user's avatar in normal video mode
Model.OtherInCallVideo: User viewing another user's avatar while in call mode

Status.True: Avatar published and live (default success state for Other to view)
Status.publicGenerating: Avatar in process of being published — waiting period after Self hit Publish
Status.placeholder: No avatar image / video yet (newly created, before any upload)
Status.ExclusiveContentLock: Other user encounters exclusive content they haven't unlocked
Status.ExclusiveContentUnlock: Other user has purchased / been granted access to exclusive content

components._default_state_note: Most common state across user contexts. Agent should pick another state only when spec explicitly mentions: creating, error, private, generating, or exclusive content access (lock/unlock).

agent_usage_hint._note: Mapping spec keywords → state / variant. Agent uses this to deterministically pick the right configuration from the spec text.

common_combinations.scenario: Self user views own avatar after publishing (normal case)
Other user views avatar with exclusive content they haven't paid for
Self user just hit Publish, avatar is being processed
Other user views avatar after unlocking exclusive content

display: Display the uploaded image at 50% opacity.

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: User started avatar creation flow (uploaded photo, configured options, hit create)
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: Wait for avatar generation to complete
next_actions: wait — system processes the upload
Call button disabled, no user actions possible during this state
_inferred_user_flow.next_state_on_success: PUBLIC (or PRIVATE if user chose private at creation time)

display: Use the same background as the Generating state
Display the status label as Error

fallback.behavior: allow users to tap and navigate to the avatar creation flow

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: Avatar generation failed (technical error during AVATAR_CREATING)
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: Recover from the error — likely retry creation
next_actions: primary: see Toast notification with error info
fallback: tap the thumbnail → navigate to avatar creation flow to retry
if Toast still visible, user may dismiss it

variants.case: Changed to private after setting tags
variants.tags: If tags exist, display them. Only the status changes (content remains unchanged).

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: Either (1) Self user kept avatar private from the start, OR (2) Self user toggled a previously public avatar to private
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: Personal viewing only — avatar not visible to Other users
next_actions: toggle Publish → enters GENERATING (then PUBLIC)
view Profile / Avatar TOP
delete avatar
_inferred_user_flow.preceded_by_variant1: AVATAR_CREATING (newly created, never published — corresponds to PRIVATE.variants[0])

GENERATING.display: Displayed when a waiting period occurs after publishing the avatar

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: Self user hit Publish from PRIVATE or settings — system is processing the public release
next_actions: wait — auto-transitions to PUBLIC when processing completes
user typically cannot interact during this state
_inferred_user_flow.next_state_on_failure: GENERATION_ERROR (rare for publish step, more common in AVATAR_CREATING)

rules: If the user has not set any tags, do not display tags.
If there are many tags, display up to four lines.

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: Either (1) GENERATING just completed (Self just published), OR (2) ambient state when Other user views any published avatar
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: View / share / interact with the published avatar
next_actions: for Self: edit tags (max 4 lines), toggle to PRIVATE
for Other: tap call button → Call screen
for Other: tap other area → Avatar TOP (avatar detail)
for Other: bookmark, follow, comment via adjacent buttons (see related_components)
_inferred_user_flow.next_state_on_exclusive_lock: Status variant changes to ExclusiveContentLock (when avatar has exclusive content and viewer is unpaid Other)

interactions.result: navigate to Avatar TOP (avatar detail screen)

related_components._note: Components that typically appear alongside avatarThumbnail or are part of its flow. Keys verified from Library catalog.

appears_alongside.name: creator-name-follow
appears_alongside.context: Creator name + follow button overlay shown with the thumbnail

appears_alongside.name: Avatar Bookmark Button
appears_alongside.context: Bookmark action — use `Size: profileThumbnail` variant for this context

appears_on_screens: Call screen (after tap callButton — navigates to call view)

caveats.text: Layout of elements on the thumbnail: Bottom-aligned, stacked upward — Hori marked this in red (#ff3e1c) in the Figma Note table
Transition rules use red border (#ff3e1c) in Figma — Hori emphasized importance
Tags display has hard max of 4 lines (display_constraints.tags.max_lines = 4)

components.name: Avatar Card

catalog_description.usage_jp: アバターを表示するメインcard。Use CaseとUserの組み合わせで画面・表示内容を切り替える。
catalog_description.usage_en: Main card displaying avatar. Switch screen and content by Use Case and User combination.
catalog_description.notes_jp: Variant配置で用途が自明。詳細はFigma上のVariant配置を参照。
catalog_description.notes_en: See Figma Variant layout for details.

_variant_aliases._note: Hori's variant values explained in plain terms (Claude-authored — Hori may refine).

Use Case.Home: Avatar Card as it appears in the Home feed (TikTok-style scroll)
Use Case.Home Pre-transition: Transition variant before zooming into Home Zoom screen (Prototype only)
Use Case.Avatar TOP: Avatar Card as it appears on Avatar TOP / Profile screen
Use Case.Zoom on Home: Avatar Card when zoomed into Home video (full-screen view)
Use Case.Publish: Avatar Card during publish flow (visibility settings)
Use Case.Locked Exclusive Content: Avatar Card showing exclusive content that is gated (paywall variant)

User.Self: User is viewing their own avatar (editor / creator perspective)
User.Other: User is viewing another user's avatar (audience / viewer perspective)

Image Type.User Set Video: Default video the user uploaded as their avatar
Image Type.InCallVideo: Live video shown when avatar is in call
Image Type.CommentKeyboard: Comment with keyboard variant (taller comment sheet for typing)

components._default_state_note: Standard browse state. Agent should pick another state only when spec mentions: locked exclusive content (LOCK), unlocked premium (UNLOCK), publish/visibility flow (PUBLISH — Self only), comment panel (COMMENT_BOTTOM_SHEET_VIEW), or transition animation (PRE_TRANSITION — prototype only, rarely use in real screens).

agent_usage_hint._note: Mapping spec keywords → state / variant. Agent uses this to deterministically pick the right configuration from spec text.

spec_signal_to_state.「animation / transition between screens」: PRE_TRANSITION (prototype-only — rarely use in real screens)

common_combinations.scenario: Other user browses Home feed and sees an avatar (no exclusive content)
Other user encounters a paywalled exclusive avatar on Home feed
Self user opens publish settings for their avatar
Other user opens comment panel from Home Zoom
Other user starts typing a comment (keyboard up)

components._inferred_flows_note: Each state has `_inferred_user_flow` field with enter_via / user_intent / next_actions. These are Claude's interpretation, NOT Hori-confirmed.

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: User opens Home feed and scrolls to this avatar / opens this avatar's Profile / Avatar Top screen
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: Browse avatar content normally (no special state)
next_actions: tap card body → PRE_TRANSITION → Home Zoom screen
tap Avatar TOP entry icon → Profile / Avatar Top screen
(Other only) swipe → R1 AD Card
tap Comment button → COMMENT_BOTTOM_SHEET_VIEW

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: User has previously purchased / been granted access to this avatar's exclusive content (state persists after purchase)
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: View the exclusive content they paid for
next_actions: tap card body → Home Zoom screen (with exclusive content visible / playable)
all DEFAULT-state interactions also available
_inferred_user_flow.preceded_by: LOCK → user completed payment / unlock flow

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: User encounters an Other avatar whose content is marked exclusive AND user has not unlocked it yet
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: Sees that exclusive content exists but is gated; may want to unlock
next_actions: tap card body → paywall / unlock flow (exact destination needs Hori confirmation)
tap Avatar TOP entry icon → Profile / Avatar Top (where unlock options may be shown)

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: User just tapped the avatar card; this is the brief animation frame between tap and full Zoom view
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: Not a user-actionable state — purely visual transition
next_actions: auto-transitions to Home Zoom screen after animation completes
_inferred_user_flow._note: Hori marked this 'for Prototype use' — exists to demonstrate animation in Figma Prototypes, not a real product state to design layouts against.

PUBLISH.description: Publish state for Self Avatar (visibility toggle, public/private)

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: Self user navigates to publish flow — either via 'visibility settings' link from Home Zoom screen, or directly from Profile / Avatar Top
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: Manage avatar visibility (set Public or Private)
next_actions: toggle Public ↔ Private
navigate to publish settings screen (per Home Zoom Self description)
exit to DEFAULT state after settings saved
_inferred_user_flow.supporting_quote_from_hori: Self: 'Emergency fallback actions for video Public / Private status, and a navigation link to the visibility settings screen.'

COMMENT_BOTTOM_SHEET_VIEW.description: Variant when Comment BottomSheet is open
COMMENT_BOTTOM_SHEET_VIEW.purpose: Two Bottom Sheet Height Variations for Layout Support

_inferred_user_flow.enter_via: User taps the Comment button on the avatar (likely from Home Zoom view)
_inferred_user_flow.user_intent: Read or write comments on the avatar's content
next_actions: scroll comments within the bottom sheet
tap input area → switches to keyboard variation (taller sheet — Image Type: CommentKeyboard)
submit a comment
swipe down / tap outside → close sheet, return to DEFAULT
_inferred_user_flow._variation_note: 2 variations correspond to: (1) sheet at standard height with comment list (Image Type: Comment), (2) sheet expanded for keyboard typing (Image Type: CommentKeyboard)

interactions.result: navigate to Home Zoom screen (the avatar's video zoom view)

_agent_integration_examples._note: Concrete 'spec → lookup → output' walkthroughs showing how an agent would use this dictionary at generation time. These are templates for the integration code (server/src/services/claude.js extension) that should be written when ≥20 components are documented.

scenario_1_self_published_avatar_on_prof.spec_text: Self user の profile 画面、avatar はすでに公開済み、tag は 3 個設定済み
lookup_steps: 1. Identify component from screen context: 'profile 画面' → look in _screens_index['Profile / Avatar Top'].components
2. Pick component: profile/avatarThumbnail (or Avatar Card depending on which is requested)
3. Pick variant from agent_usage_hint.spec_signal_to_variant:
- 'Self が自分の avatar' → Model: selfVideo
- '公開済み' → Status: True (default)
4. Pick state from agent_usage_hint.spec_signal_to_state:
- '公開済み' → PUBLIC
5. Read PUBLIC state's display rules: 'If many tags → max 4 lines'
6. Spec says 3 tags → display all 3 (within max 4 lines limit)
expected_layers: Tag list (3 tags, all visible within 4-line limit)
scenario_1_self_published_avatar_on_prof.code_snippet_sketch: const dict = libraryDict.components.find(c => c.name === 'profile/avatarThumbnail'); const variant = { Model: 'selfVideo', Status: 'True' }; const state = dict.states.PUBLIC; const displayRules = [...dict.display_rules, ...state.rules];

scenario_2_other_user_locked_exclusive_c.spec_text: Other user encounters an exclusive avatar they haven't unlocked, on Home feed
lookup_steps: 1. screen: 'Home feed' → _screens_index['Home feed'].primary_component = Avatar Card
2. spec keyword 'exclusive' + 'haven't unlocked' → agent_usage_hint.spec_signal_to_state['「限定コンテンツ / locked / 有料 paywall」'] = LOCK
3. Variant: User=Other, Use Case=Home, ExclusiveContent=True
4. Check caveats: 'critical: Self does not have LOCK' — confirm User=Other ✓
5. Lookup state.LOCK._inferred_user_flow.next_actions for interaction hints
expected_layers: Avatar Card with lock visual indicator
Tap target: navigates to Paywall / Unlock flow (per related_components.navigates_to)
agent_warnings_to_emit: Add comment '// tap → paywall flow (destination needs Hori confirmation)' in generated code
Mark navigation as _inferred for future Hori review

scenario_3_self_publishing_in_progress.spec_text: Self user just tapped Publish, waiting for processing to complete
lookup_steps: 1. Component: profile/avatarThumbnail
2. Variant: Model=selfVideo, Status=publicGenerating
3. State (from variant alias): publicGenerating maps to GENERATING state per agent_usage_hint
4. Read GENERATING.display: 'Displayed when a waiting period occurs after publishing'
5. Read _inferred_user_flow.next_actions: 'wait — auto-transitions to PUBLIC when processing completes'
scenario_3_self_publishing_in_progress.interaction_handling: agent should NOT add any tap handlers (waiting state, user can't act)

scenario_4_open_comment_panel_on_zoom.spec_text: Other user is watching Home Zoom view and opens comments
lookup_steps: 1. screen: 'Home Zoom' → components include Avatar Card + Avatar Comments Button
2. Avatar Card variant: Use Case=Zoom on Home, User=Other, Image Type=Comment (or CommentKeyboard if typing)
3. state: COMMENT_BOTTOM_SHEET_VIEW
4. variations: 2 — pick variation 1 (Comment) or 2 (CommentKeyboard) based on whether keyboard is up
5. Related components: Avatar Comments Button (key c0ef7e71...) handles trigger
expected_layers: Avatar Card (Image Type: Comment) — bottom sheet at standard height
Input area at bottom (taps activate keyboard variation)
scenario_4_open_comment_panel_on_zoom._inferred_warning: Whether keyboard appears with sheet at standard height or expanded is _inferred — confirm with Hori if 2 variations differ this way

scenario_5_generation_error_recovery.spec_text: User's avatar generation failed, show error state with recovery option
lookup_steps: 1. Component: profile/avatarThumbnail
2. state: GENERATION_ERROR (from agent_usage_hint spec_signal '生成エラー')
3. Read state.display: 'Use the same background as the Generating state, Display status label as Error'
4. Read state.primary_feedback: 'Toast notification'
5. Read state.fallback: 'condition: Toast has already disappeared, behavior: allow tap → avatar creation flow'
6. Generate both primary (Toast trigger placeholder) and fallback (tap → creation flow)
expected_layers: (Toast component is separate — usually handled at screen level, not in component)
Tap handler on whole thumbnail → navigate to avatar creation flow (fallback only)
scenario_5_generation_error_recovery.agent_note: Toast is screen-level UI not in this component — agent shouldn't generate Toast as child of thumbnail
